SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.unit AS unit, COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity), 0) AS openingQty, COALESCE(SUM(s.cost_total), 0) AS openingAmount FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT goods_id AS id, goods_code, goods_name, unit FROM mis_stock WHERE del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT DISTINCT goods_id, goods_code, goods_name, unit FROM mis_stock_in_detail WHERE del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT DISTINCT goods_id, goods_code, goods_name, unit FROM mis_stock_out_detail WHERE del_flag = '0' ) g LEFT JOIN mis_stock s ON g.id = s.goods_id AND s.del_flag = '0'
AND s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
g.goods_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{goodsCode}, '%')
GROUP BY g.id, g.goods_code, g.goods_name, g.unit

SELECT sid.goods_id AS goods_id, SUM(sid.actual_qty) AS qty, SUM(sid.total_amount) AS amount FROM mis_stock_in_detail sid INNER JOIN mis_stock_in si ON sid.stock_in_id = si.id AND si.status = 'FINISHED' AND si.del_flag = '0' AND DATE_FORMAT(si.stock_in_time, '%Y-%m') = #{period} WHERE sid.del_flag = '0'
AND si.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
AND sid.goods_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{goodsCode}, '%')
GROUP BY sid.goods_id

AND so.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
AND sod.goods_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{goodsCode}, '%')
GROUP BY sod.goods_id
